messages.Greutatea \\(\\vec G = m\\vec g\\) a unu: The weight \(\vec G = m\vec g\) of a body on a plane inclined at angle \(\alpha\) resolves into a component parallel to the plane and one perpendicular to it:
messages.\\[ \\vec G = \\vec G_t + \\vec G_n \\]: \[ \vec G = \vec G_t + \vec G_n \] \[ G_t = mg\sin\alpha, \qquad G_n = mg\cos\alpha \]
messages.Unghiul dintre \\(\\vec G\\) și \\(\\vec: The angle between \(\vec G\) and \(\vec G_n\) equals the plane's angle \(\alpha\) — their respective sides are perpendicular.
messages.\\(\\vec G_t\\) trage corpul în josul pl: \(\vec G_t\) pulls the body down the plane, while \(\vec G_n\) presses it into the plane and is balanced by the normal reaction: \(N = mg\cos\alpha\). Sliding friction is \(F_f = \mu N = \mu mg\cos\alpha\).
